name: Rossmoor Shopping Center
summary: Rossmoor Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination in Walnut Creek serving the affluent Rossmoor retirement community and surrounding Tice Valley area. This well-maintained community center offers convenient access to essential services and shopping for local residents in one of the East Bay's most desirable locations.
demographics: Rossmoor Shopping Center primarily serves the affluent Rossmoor retirement community and surrounding Walnut Creek neighborhoods, attracting predominantly senior residents aged 55+ with above-average household incomes and significant retirement savings. The trade area includes established families and professionals from the Tice Valley area who value convenience and quality over trendy shopping experiences. Typical visitors are homeowners seeking everyday necessities, pharmacy services, and dining options within a comfortable, accessible environment that caters to mature shoppers with disposable income.
description: Rossmoor Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located at 1900 Tice Valley Boulevard in Walnut Creek, California, serving the prestigious Rossmoor retirement community and surrounding residential areas. This community-oriented shopping center has been a cornerstone of convenience for local residents for decades, offering essential services and retail options in an accessible, open-air format. The center's strategic location in one of the East Bay's most desirable neighborhoods makes it a natural gathering place for the community, providing easy access to daily necessities without the need to venture into larger commercial districts. With a solid 4.1-star rating from local shoppers, the center has built a reputation for reliable service and tenant mix that caters specifically to the needs of its mature, affluent customer base. The shopping center's management by Citivest Commercial ensures professional oversight and tenant curation that maintains the center's appeal to both visitors and retailers seeking to serve this valuable demographic market.
